brief: Indexes the methods and doc blocks of many classes at once, so a plain-English question finds the method and the class that holds it.
detail: It harvests each named class with its inherited methods from the source, files every method under the class that defines it, and adds the intent recipes, small units that answer a how-do-I question with a runnable snippet. Ask ranks the entries by the meaning of the words: a lexical match first, with a loaded embedding or reranker model rescuing questions that share no word. Nothing is generated; the answer is always something the library already holds. Keep the class list short, since a large list costs index time when an embedding model is loaded.
example: ? o1.Ask("detect the language of a text")[1][1]
